title: e2e oracle harness: structural byte-parsers read CWS as FWS (3 false failures)
description: RESOLVED (harness bug, not product defect). Root cause: __flashTest.publish() returns a COMPRESSED CWS SWF (publishSettings.compress=true), but the 3 structural oracles walked the tag stream from RAW byte 8 = start of the zlib body, reading garbage tag types (verified: naive walk yields 803,16,369,1014 matching reported 811,16,369). Fix (e2e-only): new apps/desktop/e2e/helpers/swf-parse.ts decompressSwf()+parseSwfTags() inflate CWS before walking; shape-morph/motion-guide/fla-roundtrip now use it. Also fixed fla-roundtrip: publish() is async (returns Promise<string>) but FlashTestBridge typed it string and the structure test missed the await (swf.length on a Promise = undefined); type now Promise<string>, call site awaits. NO product code touched (diff entirely under apps/desktop/e2e/). VERIFIED via real Playwright (chromium installed, ruffle assets restored from node_modules @ruffle-rs/ruffle 0.2.0): cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/shape-morph.spec.ts e2e/motion-guide.spec.ts e2e/fla-roundtrip.spec.ts -> the 3 target structural tests PASS: shape-morph:318 tag-84 found (tags 69,41,9,84,26,1,...), motion-guide:530 ShowFrame=5/PlaceObject2=5/DefineSprite=1 guide excluded, fla-roundtrip:371 walks 0,1,9,12,26,28,37,39,41,69,73,74,75,83. Full 3-spec run with ruffle restored: 12/13 pass (the 1 fail = shape-morph:393 Ruffle mid-frame interpolation timing flake, passes on retry, unrelated to this harness work). Unit suites: @flash/swf 1386/1386 pass, @flash/authoring-ui 653/653 pass, @flash/core only the pre-existing ~3 task-1207 FLA-fixture failures (empty-bytematch/carchive-validate/contents-structure; identical on origin/main baseline).
